draco.rationale: Cesium 1.138 ships the Draco decoder (draco_decoder.wasm) and the production CSP allows 'wasm-unsafe-eval' and blob: workers; Draco worker contention with photogrammetry is measured in T7.

budget.axes: glTF +Y up / +Z forward pass through the Cesium axis correction, the matrix Y_UP_TO_Z_UP·Z_UP_TO_X_UP (on a vertex Z_UP_TO_X_UP applies first); net mapping glTF +X→+Y, +Y→+Z, +Z→+X, so the model local frame is +Z up / +X forward; the T3 LVLH law maps onto that converted frame.

std.rationale: Memory exception: ~13.4 MB estimated decoded GPU footprint, almost all textures (4 x 512x1024 + 1 x 512x512).

low.rationale: In the low profile Hubble gets no model; it renders as a point only.
